title: Fix ShortSport auto-scroll toggle placement and video zoom issue

requirements.text: Add an auto-scroll toggle button in the ShortSport page at the bottom-left area, positioned between the share and comment buttons. The toggle must not overlap any video content or other UI elements. When enabled, the feed should automatically scroll to the next video once the current video finishes playing.

quotes: The auto scroll option that make the shortsport scroll automatically when the shortsport video complete at once it scroll down to the next video is not showing why fix it (and put it in bottom side anywhere where place is empty not overlay it)
1.Bottom left middle the share and comment option just in shortsport

acceptanceCriteria: An auto-scroll toggle button is visible on the ShortSport page at the bottom-left, between the share and comment buttons.
The toggle does not overlap any video content, captions, username, or other UI elements.
When the toggle is ON and the current video ends, the feed automatically scrolls to the next video.
When the toggle is OFF, the feed does not auto-scroll on video completion.
The toggle state persists while the user remains on the ShortSport page.

requirements.text: Remove the zoom/crop effect from ShortSport videos so each video renders at its original aspect ratio and size without being cropped or scaled up. Ensure the post creator's username, profile avatar, and the video caption are fully visible and not hidden behind or beneath the video.

quotes: the shortsport bit zoom the title or caption of the video never seen as well as post user profile
2.dont zoom it like that it hide the post's user name and caption of the video also the video should look original original size

acceptanceCriteria: ShortSport videos are displayed at their original size/aspect ratio without any zoom or crop applied.
The post creator's username and profile avatar are fully visible on every ShortSport card.
The video caption is fully readable and not hidden or clipped by the video element.
No content (username, caption, avatar) is obscured by the video container at any screen size.

constraints: Changes must only affect the ShortSport page (frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx) and any directly related components.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
The auto-scroll toggle must not overlay or obscure any video content.
nonGoals: Changes to any page other than ShortSport.
Redesigning the overall ShortSport UI layout beyond what is required for these two fixes.
